before: Weigh accepted batch on calibrated scale; exclude rejected stakes and packaging; Calculate the recorded numerator as follows: net accepted stake mass; all exchanges divided by this same mass.
after: Weigh the accepted batch on a calibrated scale, excluding rejected stakes and packaging. Record its raw net accepted campaign mass B in kg; this is the common denominator, not an exchange already divided by B.

before: Weigh delivered chestnut logs and reconcile opening/closing stock and traced upstream delivery; Calculate the recorded numerator as follows: consumed delivered roundwood / same accepted net stake kg.
after: Weigh delivered chestnut logs and reconcile opening/closing stock and traced upstream delivery. Record consumed delivered roundwood as raw campaign kg, without division by B.

before: Read calibrated meters and isolate actual attributable demand; reconcile to purchased supply; Calculate the recorded numerator as follows: attributable purchased kWh × 3.6 / same accepted net stake kg.
after: Read calibrated meters and isolate actual attributable demand; reconcile to purchased supply. Convert attributable purchased campaign kWh to raw campaign MJ by multiplying by 3.6 once, without division by B.

before: Measure net consumption and recovered used oil independently; inspect loss pathways; Calculate the recorded numerator as follows: each distinct input or output kg / same accepted net stake kg.
after: Measure net consumption and recovered used oil independently; inspect loss pathways. Record each distinct input or output as separate raw campaign kg, without division by B.

before: Weigh PP twine issued less returns and reconcile material actually shipped; Calculate the recorded numerator as follows: shipped twine kg / same accepted net stake kg.
after: Weigh PP twine issued less returns and reconcile material actually shipped. Record shipped twine as raw campaign kg, without division by B.

before: Weigh segregated residue streams; reconcile mass, dust capture and destinations; Calculate the recorded numerator as follows: each distinct waste kg / same accepted net stake kg.
after: Weigh segregated residue streams; reconcile mass, dust capture and destinations. Record each distinct waste stream as separate raw campaign kg, without division by B.

before: Measure actual outdoor releases with validated particle-size sampling and traced activity integration; characterize fugitive releases separately; Calculate the recorded numerator as follows: each exclusive emitted particle fraction kg / same accepted net stake kg.
after: Measure actual outdoor releases with validated particle-size sampling and traced activity integration; characterize fugitive releases separately. Record each exclusive emitted particle fraction as separate raw campaign kg, without division by B.

before: Use paired same-lot wet/dry samples and traceable mass records; reconcile actual seasoning/storage water loss separately from liquid drainage; Calculate the recorded numerator as follows: evaporated water kg / same accepted net stake kg.
after: Use paired same-lot wet/dry samples and traceable mass records; reconcile actual seasoning/storage water loss separately from liquid drainage. Record evaporated water from the physical water balance as raw campaign kg, without division by B.

before: Inspect actual process and supplier records; identify all conditional and unlisted physical exchanges; Calculate the recorded numerator as follows: route records refer to the same batch or campaign and per 1 kg reference flow.
after: Inspect the actual process and supplier records; identify all conditional and unlisted physical exchanges. Keep observations for the same batch or campaign; route observations are not a numerical exchange numerator.
